_meta.purpose: Authority-anchored special-frame chart corpus for PR-7/9 jonggyeok calibration. Most public sources expose four pillars rather than birth timestamps, so tests validate pillar-only cases as data intake and reserve engine comparison for cases that include birth.

intakeRequirements.sourceTier: T3_AUTHORED_INTERPRETATION or higher, with sourceUrl/short quote/human interpretation and authorityTruthEligible=true
intakeRequirements.expectedJonggyeokType: CONG_CAI | CONG_GUAN | CONG_SHA | CONG_ER | CONG_YIN | CONG_BI | ZHUAN_WANG | HUA_QI
intakeRequirements.note: When birth is unavailable, birth is null and pillars is a four-ganji string in year month day hour order. Engine comparison is skipped until direct-pillar analysis is supported.

_meta.promotionCriteria: 20+ cases plus 80%+ calibrated match only when 20+ engine-comparable birth cases exist. Pillar-only cases are source intake and subtype coverage evidence, not an engine denominator yet.

sourceTier.humanInterpretation: The fixture now contains reviewed public web/source-anchored special-frame cases. Case-level sourceTier blocks provide the authority anchor.
sourceTier.copyrightNote: Stores only four-pillar facts, short quotes, URLs, and human paraphrase; no bulk prose copied.
